Privacy Policy

Updated October 10, 2026 · Applies to the public Lizzy Finds website

Information this website collects

This version has no account system, analytics, advertising scripts, contact form or newsletter. It does not set cookies or use browser storage. The comparison calculator runs in your browser; its inputs are not uploaded to a server.

Access logs

This website is hosted on GitHub Pages. GitHub logs and stores visitor IP addresses for security purposes, including when visitors are not signed in to GitHub. See the GitHub Privacy Statement for how GitHub processes hosting-related data.

Contact by email

If you email Lizzy, your email address, message and any information you choose to include are processed through the email provider to respond to your enquiry. Please avoid sending sensitive personal information. You can contact Lizzy to request deletion of correspondence, subject to any applicable retention obligations.

External links

Links to Sony and other sources take you to independent websites governed by their own privacy policies. The Shokz guide loads product images supplied through PartnerBoost from Amazon image servers. Loading these images sends your IP address and browser request information to Amazon. No external fonts are loaded.

Updates and contact

The date above will change when this policy is revised. Questions can be sent to wanghz0512@gmail.com.
